updates.content:
Title: Some admins may see Microsoft Teams usage report data discrepancies in the Microsoft 365 admin center

User impact: Admins may see Microsoft Teams usage report data discrepancies in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

More info: Admins may see the following inaccuracies in Microsoft Teams usage reports starting from August 25, 2026:

- Teams Active Users may display as 0
- Teams Chat Messages may display as 0
- Teams Channel Messages may display as 0

Current status: We've received reports from a subset of admins noting inaccuracies or discrepancies in Microsoft Teams usage reports in the Microsoft 365 admin center starting from August 25, 2026.  We're attempting to reproduce the issue to further our understanding of the current impact scenario and to determine our next troubleshooting steps.

Scope of impact: This event impacts some admins, who may see Microsoft Teams usage report data discrepancies in the Microsoft 365 admin center starting from August 25, 2026. This section may be updated as the investigation progresses.

Next update by: Thursday, September 10, 2026, at 11:00 PM UTC
